messages:
Priya: Flagging a tiny but annoying pattern in Private setup: a bunch of customers fail on DNS resolution (split-horizon / internal zones). Thinking we should add a small DNS troubleshooting card in the network step. Thoughts?
Jon: yes. DNS failures are common. We should show tailored hints only when the connection check shows a name resolution error, not always. :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim: agree. if we auto-surface hints, keep them concise: common culprits are internal-only hostnames, missing search domains, or wrong /etc/hosts. maybe include a one-line command users can run: `dig +short @8.8.8.8 my-private-host.internal`
Sasha: copy nit: avoid 'internal' jargon for some customers. propose header: "Can't resolve your host?" and body: "Try these quick checks: DNS server, search domains, local hosts file, VPN split-tunnel." add a 'Show commands' expander.
Priya: UX detail: should we auto-expand the card on first DNS failure or leave it collapsed with a subtle inline hint? Auto-expand helps reduce support tickets but can be noisy.
Jon: auto-expand on the first failure per workspace, then collapse for subsequent failures unless the user clicks 'Keep open'. persist in localStorage / workspace setting.
Ibrahim: a11y: when we auto-open the card, move focus into the card and announce via an aria-live region: "DNS troubleshooting opened". also include sr-only text for icons and avoid color-only status.
Sasha: for the commands drawer include copy buttons and a shallow tooltip that says "Copied!" that is also announced to screen readers (use role="status").
Priya: what commands do we include? I propose: `dig A my-host.example.com`, `nslookup my-host.example.com`, `curl -v http://<ip>:<port>` and a sample hosts file snippet. Keep them read-only, not editable.
Jon: add a short explanation for split-horizon DNS: "If your hostname resolves only from inside your VPC or VPN, try running the command from a machine on the same network or use an IP address instead." short, link to KB for details.
Ibrahim: telemetry: track `dns_hint_shown`, `dns_hint_opened`, `dns_cmd_copied` with reason tags (e.g., NXDOMAIN, timeout). helps us measure impact and iterate on copy.
Sasha: accessibility followups: ensure the expander button has `aria-controls` + `aria-expanded`, and that the commands area uses a live region for copy confirmations. also test with VoiceOver on mac.
Priya: design ask: can someone mock the collapsed hint + expanded drawer with commands + small inline KB link? also need microcopy for the hosts sample.
Jon: I'll sketch two variants: subtle inline hint vs. auto-open card with summary. will post Figma links and alt copy options later today.
Sasha: I'll draft the SR text for icons and the live region wording and run a quick a11y checklist.
